name: Test Codecov proxy-action

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'proxy-actions/codecov/**'
      - '.github/workflows/test-proxy-action-codecov.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-codecov-proxy:
    name: Test codecov proxy action
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@93cb6efe18208431cddfb8368fd83d5badbf9bfd # v5.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run codecov proxy action
        uses: ./proxy-actions/codecov
        with:
          handle_no_reports_found: true

  check-default-version:
    name: Check if default version of codecov CLI is present in the action
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@93cb6efe18208431cddfb8368fd83d5badbf9bfd # v5.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify default version
        run: |
            VERSION=$(yq -r '.inputs.version.default' ./proxy-actions/codecov/action.yml)
            if [ -z "$VERSION" ] || [ "$VERSION" = "null" ]; then
              echo "Error: Default version is null or empty"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Default version: $VERSION"

name: Test Trigger Actions

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "trigger-actions/**"
      - ".github/workflows/test-trigger-actions.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test Trigger Actions
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      deployments: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out repo
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run trigger-actions
        id: trigger
        uses: ./trigger-actions
        with:
          azure_subscription_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
          azure_tenant_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          azure_client_id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          task: test-trigger-actions
          data: '{"test": true}'
          test: "true"
          # The simulate-downstream job (running in parallel) drives this
          # deployment to `success` within ~30-45s. 3 minutes is the safety net.
          monitor-timeout-minutes: "3"

      - name: Verify deployment payload
        id: verify-deployment-payload
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          DEPLOYMENT_ID: ${{ steps.trigger.outputs.deployment-id }}
          EXPECTED_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          if [[ -z "$DEPLOYMENT_ID" ]]; then
            echo "::error::trigger-actions did not output deployment-id"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "deployment-id from composite output: $DEPLOYMENT_ID"

          PAYLOAD=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/deployments/$DEPLOYMENT_ID" --jq '.payload')

          RUN_ID=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.run.id')
          RUN_WORKFLOW=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.run.workflow')
          ARTIFACT_NAME=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.run.artifact.name')
          GIT_SHA=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.git.sha')
          GIT_BRANCH=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.git.branch')
          GIT_OWNER=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.git.owner')
          GIT_REPO=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.git.repo')

          check() {
            local field="$1" actual="$2" expected="$3"
            if [[ "$actual" != "$expected" ]]; then
              echo "::error::payload.$field: expected '$expected', got '$actual'"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "payload.$field: ✓ ($actual)"
          }

          check "run.id" "$RUN_ID" "$EXPECTED_RUN_ID"
          check "run.workflow" "$RUN_WORKFLOW" "test-trigger-actions.yml"

          if [[ ! "$ARTIFACT_NAME" =~ ^trigger-context(-[a-f0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::payload.run.artifact.name: expected pattern 'trigger-context(-[a-f0-9]+)?', got '$ARTIFACT_NAME'"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "payload.run.artifact.name: ✓ ($ARTIFACT_NAME)"

          check "git.sha" "$GIT_SHA" "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          check "git.owner" "$GIT_OWNER" "bitwarden"
          check "git.repo" "$GIT_REPO" "gh-actions"

          if [[ -z "$GIT_BRANCH" || "$GIT_BRANCH" == "null" ]]; then
            echo "::error::payload.git.branch is empty"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "payload.git.branch: ✓ ($GIT_BRANCH)"

          echo "artifact_name=$ARTIFACT_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Download trigger context artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@37930b1c2abaa49bbe596cd826c3c89aef350131 # v7.0.0
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.verify-deployment-payload.outputs.artifact_name }}
          path: trigger-context

      - name: Verify trigger context
        run: |
          if [[ ! -f trigger-context/trigger-context.json ]]; then
            echo "::error::trigger-context.json not found in artifact"
            exit 1
          fi

          INPUTS=$(jq -r '.inputs' trigger-context/trigger-context.json)
          if [[ "$INPUTS" == "null" ]]; then
            echo "::error::trigger-context.json missing 'inputs' key"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "context.inputs: ✓"

          DATA_TEST=$(jq -r '.data.test' trigger-context/trigger-context.json)
          if [[ "$DATA_TEST" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "::error::context.data.test: expected 'true', got '$DATA_TEST'"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "context.data: ✓"

      - name: Verify in_progress status carried log_url
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          DEPLOYMENT_ID: ${{ steps.trigger.outputs.deployment-id }}
          EXPECTED_LOG_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          LOG_URL=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/deployments/$DEPLOYMENT_ID/statuses?per_page=100" \
            --jq '[.[] | select(.state == "in_progress") | .log_url | select(. != null and . != "")][0] // empty')
          if [[ "$LOG_URL" != "$EXPECTED_LOG_URL" ]]; then
            echo "::error::in_progress status log_url: expected '$EXPECTED_LOG_URL', got '$LOG_URL'"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "in_progress log_url: ✓ ($LOG_URL)"

      - name: Cleanup all trigger-actions deployments
        if: always()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          DEPLOYMENT_IDS=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/deployments?environment=trigger-actions&per_page=100" \
            --jq '.[].id')

          for ID in $DEPLOYMENT_IDS; do
            gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/deployments/$ID/statuses" \
              --method POST \
              -f state=inactive
            gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/deployments/$ID" \
              --method DELETE
            echo "Deleted deployment $ID"
          done

  simulate-downstream:
    name: Simulate Downstream Success
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      deployments: write
    steps:
      - name: Find the deployment created by the test job
        id: find
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          # Poll up to 30 times (5s each = 150s budget) for the deployment
          # whose payload.run.id matches the current workflow run.
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            DEPLOYMENT_ID=$(gh api \
              "repos/$REPOSITORY/deployments?environment=trigger-actions&task=test-trigger-actions&per_page=30" \
              --jq "[.[] | select(.payload.run.id == ${RUN_ID}) | .id][0] // empty")
            if [[ -n "$DEPLOYMENT_ID" ]]; then
              echo "Found deployment $DEPLOYMENT_ID for run $RUN_ID (after $((i * 5))s)"
              echo "deployment_id=$DEPLOYMENT_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "::error::Did not find a trigger-actions deployment from run $RUN_ID within 150s"
          exit 1

      - name: Post in_progress status
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          DEPLOYMENT_ID: ${{ steps.find.outputs.deployment_id }}
          # Stand in for the dispatched downstream run URL so the monitor's
          # "Deployment Tracking" summary + log link get exercised.
          LOG_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/deployments/$DEPLOYMENT_ID/statuses" \
            --method POST \
            -f state=in_progress \
            -f log_url="$LOG_URL" \
            -f description="Simulated: downstream started"
          echo "Posted in_progress (log_url=$LOG_URL) on deployment $DEPLOYMENT_ID"

      - name: Wait so the monitor logs the in_progress status
        run: sleep 15

      - name: Post success status
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          DEPLOYMENT_ID: ${{ steps.find.outputs.deployment_id }}
        run: |
          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/deployments/$DEPLOYMENT_ID/statuses" \
            --method POST \
            -f state=success \
            -f description="Simulated: downstream completed"
          echo "Posted success on deployment $DEPLOYMENT_ID"

name: Test Check Permission Action

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "check-permission/**"
      - ".github/workflows/test-check-permission.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-fail-mode:
    name: Test Fail Mode
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check permission (should pass for repo collaborators)
        id: check-fail
        uses: ./check-permission
        with:
          require: read
          username: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          failure_mode: fail

      - name: Verify output
        env:
          HAS_PERMISSION: ${{ steps.check-fail.outputs.has_permission }}
          USER_PERMISSION: ${{ steps.check-fail.outputs.user_permission }}
          SHOULD_PROCEED: ${{ steps.check-fail.outputs.should_proceed }}
        run: |
          echo "Has permission: $HAS_PERMISSION"
          echo "User permission: $USER_PERMISSION"
          echo "Should proceed: $SHOULD_PROCEED"

  test-skip-mode:
    name: Test skip mode
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check permission (always succeeds with skip mode)
        id: check-skip
        uses: ./check-permission
        with:
          require: admin
          username: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          failure_mode: skip

      - name: Conditional step
        if: steps.check-skip.outputs.should_proceed == 'true'
        run: echo "Would run privileged operation"

      - name: Skip notification
        if: steps.check-skip.outputs.should_proceed != 'true'
        run: echo "Skipped privileged operation due to permissions"

  test-continue-mode:
    name: Test continue mode
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check permission with continue mode
        id: permission
        uses: ./check-permission
        with:
          require: write
          username: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          failure_mode: continue

      - name: Admin operations
        if: steps.permission.outputs.user_permission == 'admin'
        run: echo "Running admin-level operations"

      - name: Write operations
        if: steps.permission.outputs.user_permission == 'write'
        run: echo "Running write-level operations"

      - name: Read operations
        if: steps.permission.outputs.user_permission == 'read'
        run: echo "Running read-level operations"

      - name: Always runs
        env:
          USER_PERMISSION: ${{ steps.permission.outputs.user_permission }}
          HAS_PERMISSION: ${{ steps.permission.outputs.has_permission }}
        run: |
          echo "This step always runs"
          echo "User permission: $USER_PERMISSION"
          echo "Has required permission: $HAS_PERMISSION"

  test-fallback-pattern:
    name: Test fallback pattern
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check admin permission (preferred)
        id: check-admin
        uses: ./check-permission
        with:
          require: admin
          username: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          failure_mode: skip

      - name: Check write permission (fallback)
        if: steps.check-admin.outputs.should_proceed != 'true'
        id: check-write
        uses: ./check-permission
        with:
          require: write
          username: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          failure_mode: skip

      - name: Report results
        env:
          ACTOR: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
          ADMIN_PERM: ${{ steps.check-admin.outputs.has_permission }}
          WRITE_PERM: ${{ steps.check-write.outputs.has_permission }}
          ACTUAL_PERM: ${{ steps.check-admin.outputs.user_permission }}
        run: |
          echo "User: $ACTOR"
          echo "Admin permission: $ADMIN_PERM"
          echo "Write permission: $WRITE_PERM"
          echo "Actual permission: $ACTUAL_PERM"

name: Test API Commit Action

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "api-commit/**"
      - ".github/workflows/test-api-commit.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-api:
    name: Test API commit (${{ matrix.mode }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        mode:
          # Basic input modes
          - explicit-files
          - auto-detect-files
          - no-changes
          - tag
          # Deletions
          - explicit-deletions
          - auto-detect-deletions
          # working-directory
          - working-directory
          - working-directory-explicit
          # Combined additions + deletions
          - mixed-explicit
          - mixed-auto-detect
          - auto-detect-rename
          # Edge cases
          - tree-unchanged
          - file-modes
          - refs-heads-prefix
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Create test branch
        id: setup
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
          TEST_BRANCH="api-commit-${{ matrix.mode }}-$TIMESTAMP"
          echo "test_branch=$TEST_BRANCH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "test_tag=api-commit-tag-test-$TIMESTAMP" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          SHA=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/main" --jq '.object.sha')
          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/refs" \
            --method POST \
            -f "ref=refs/heads/$TEST_BRANCH" \
            -f "sha=$SHA"

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # explicit-files: two files in repo root, passed via `files:`
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Create test files (explicit files)
        if: matrix.mode == 'explicit-files'
        run: |
          echo "content $(date +%s)" > api-commit-test-file-1.txt
          echo "content $(date +%s)" > api-commit-test-file-2.txt

      - name: Run API Commit action (explicit files)
        id: api-commit-explicit
        if: matrix.mode == 'explicit-files'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: |
            api-commit-test-file-1.txt
            api-commit-test-file-2.txt
          message: "chore: test API commit"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # auto-detect-files: staged addition picked up by git diff
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Create and stage test file (auto-detect files)
        if: matrix.mode == 'auto-detect-files'
        run: |
          echo "content $(date +%s)" > api-commit-auto-test-file.txt
          git add api-commit-auto-test-file.txt

      - name: Run API Commit action (auto-detect files)
        id: api-commit-auto
        if: matrix.mode == 'auto-detect-files'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          message: "chore: test API commit auto-detect"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # no-changes: auto-detect with no working-tree or staged changes
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run API Commit action (no changes)
        id: api-commit-no-changes
        if: matrix.mode == 'no-changes'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          message: "chore: test API commit no changes"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # tag: explicit file + tag_name creates a tag at the new commit
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Create test file (tag)
        if: matrix.mode == 'tag'
        run: |
          echo "content $(date +%s)" > api-commit-tag-test-file.txt

      - name: Run API Commit action (tag)
        id: api-commit-tag
        if: matrix.mode == 'tag'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: api-commit-tag-test-file.txt
          message: "chore: test API commit with tag"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          tag_name: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_tag }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # explicit-deletions: seed a file via Contents API, then delete via input
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Seed marker file on test branch (explicit deletions)
        if: matrix.mode == 'explicit-deletions'
        id: seed-explicit
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
          MARKER_PATH="api-commit-explicit-deletions-marker-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          MARKER_B64=$(printf 'marker %s' "$TIMESTAMP" | base64 -w0)
          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/contents/$MARKER_PATH" \
            --method PUT \
            -f "message=seed marker for deletion test" \
            -f "branch=$BRANCH" \
            -f "content=$MARKER_B64" >/dev/null
          echo "path=$MARKER_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run API Commit action (explicit deletions)
        id: api-commit-explicit-deletions
        if: matrix.mode == 'explicit-deletions'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          deletions: ${{ steps.seed-explicit.outputs.path }}
          message: "chore: test API commit explicit deletions"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # auto-detect-deletions: seed file on branch, synthetic local commit + git rm
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Stage marker on disk (auto-detect deletions)
        if: matrix.mode == 'auto-detect-deletions'
        id: seed-auto
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
          MARKER_PATH="api-commit-auto-deletions-marker-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          printf 'marker %s\n' "$TIMESTAMP" > "$MARKER_PATH"
          echo "path=$MARKER_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Seed marker on test branch via api-commit (auto-detect deletions)
        if: matrix.mode == 'auto-detect-deletions'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: ${{ steps.seed-auto.outputs.path }}
          message: "seed marker for auto-detect deletion test"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Stage local deletion (auto-detect deletions)
        if: matrix.mode == 'auto-detect-deletions'
        env:
          MARKER_PATH: ${{ steps.seed-auto.outputs.path }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "api-commit-test"
          git config user.email "api-commit-test@example.invalid"
          git add "$MARKER_PATH"
          git commit -m "synthetic local seed for deletion test"
          git rm "$MARKER_PATH"

      - name: Run API Commit action (auto-detect deletions)
        id: api-commit-auto-deletions
        if: matrix.mode == 'auto-detect-deletions'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          message: "chore: test API commit auto-detect deletions"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # working-directory: clone repo into sub/, auto-detect addition
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Clone repo into subdirectory (working-directory)
        if: matrix.mode == 'working-directory'
        env:
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
        run: |
          git clone "https://github.com/$REPOSITORY.git" sub
          git -C sub checkout "$BRANCH"
          echo "content $(date +%s)" > sub/api-commit-workingdir-test-file.txt
          git -C sub add api-commit-workingdir-test-file.txt

      - name: Run API Commit action (working-directory)
        id: api-commit-workingdir
        if: matrix.mode == 'working-directory'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          working-directory: sub
          message: "chore: test API commit working-directory"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # working-directory-explicit: working-directory + explicit files + deletions
      # Verifies the working-directory input plays nicely with explicit-mode and
      # that commit paths land at the unprefixed location in the target repo.
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Seed marker in subdir (working-directory-explicit)
        if: matrix.mode == 'working-directory-explicit'
        id: seed-wd-explicit
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
          OLD_PATH="api-commit-wd-explicit-old-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          NEW_PATH="api-commit-wd-explicit-new-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          OLD_B64=$(printf 'old' | base64 -w0)
          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/contents/$OLD_PATH" \
            --method PUT \
            -f "message=seed marker for wd-explicit test" \
            -f "branch=$BRANCH" \
            -f "content=$OLD_B64" >/dev/null
          mkdir sub
          (cd sub && git clone "https://github.com/$REPOSITORY.git" . && git checkout "$BRANCH")
          echo "new content $TIMESTAMP" > "sub/$NEW_PATH"
          {
            echo "old_path=$OLD_PATH"
            echo "new_path=$NEW_PATH"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run API Commit action (working-directory-explicit)
        id: api-commit-wd-explicit
        if: matrix.mode == 'working-directory-explicit'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          working-directory: sub
          files: ${{ steps.seed-wd-explicit.outputs.new_path }}
          deletions: ${{ steps.seed-wd-explicit.outputs.old_path }}
          message: "chore: test API commit working-directory + explicit files+deletions"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # mixed-explicit: explicit `files` + `deletions` in one commit. Uses
      # subdirectory paths to also exercise subdir support.
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Seed old subdir file on branch (mixed-explicit)
        if: matrix.mode == 'mixed-explicit'
        id: seed-mixed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
          OLD_PATH="api-commit-mixed/subdir/old-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          NEW_PATH="api-commit-mixed/subdir/new-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          OLD_B64=$(printf 'old' | base64 -w0)
          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/contents/$OLD_PATH" \
            --method PUT \
            -f "message=seed marker for mixed-explicit test" \
            -f "branch=$BRANCH" \
            -f "content=$OLD_B64" >/dev/null
          mkdir -p api-commit-mixed/subdir
          echo "new content $TIMESTAMP" > "$NEW_PATH"
          {
            echo "old_path=$OLD_PATH"
            echo "new_path=$NEW_PATH"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run API Commit action (mixed-explicit)
        id: api-commit-mixed
        if: matrix.mode == 'mixed-explicit'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: ${{ steps.seed-mixed.outputs.new_path }}
          deletions: ${{ steps.seed-mixed.outputs.old_path }}
          message: "chore: test API commit mixed explicit"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # mixed-auto-detect: local addition + local deletion, both picked up
      # via `git diff` in one commit.
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Seed marker on disk (mixed-auto-detect)
        if: matrix.mode == 'mixed-auto-detect'
        id: seed-mixed-auto
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
          OLD_PATH="api-commit-mixed-auto-old-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          NEW_PATH="api-commit-mixed-auto-new-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          printf 'old %s\n' "$TIMESTAMP" > "$OLD_PATH"
          {
            echo "old_path=$OLD_PATH"
            echo "new_path=$NEW_PATH"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Seed old marker on test branch via api-commit (mixed-auto-detect)
        if: matrix.mode == 'mixed-auto-detect'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: ${{ steps.seed-mixed-auto.outputs.old_path }}
          message: "seed old marker for mixed auto-detect test"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Stage local addition + deletion (mixed-auto-detect)
        if: matrix.mode == 'mixed-auto-detect'
        env:
          OLD_PATH: ${{ steps.seed-mixed-auto.outputs.old_path }}
          NEW_PATH: ${{ steps.seed-mixed-auto.outputs.new_path }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "api-commit-test"
          git config user.email "api-commit-test@example.invalid"
          # Synthetic local commit so the old marker is in local HEAD
          git add "$OLD_PATH"
          git commit -m "synthetic local seed for mixed auto-detect test"
          # Delete the old marker (staged) and stage the new one
          git rm "$OLD_PATH"
          printf 'new content\n' > "$NEW_PATH"
          git add "$NEW_PATH"

      - name: Run API Commit action (mixed-auto-detect)
        id: api-commit-mixed-auto
        if: matrix.mode == 'mixed-auto-detect'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          message: "chore: test API commit mixed auto-detect"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # auto-detect-rename: `git mv old new` should produce a commit that both
      # adds the new path AND deletes the old one. Without --no-renames in the
      # action's git diff, git's default rename detection would surface the
      # rename only as the destination path under the `R` status — silently
      # dropping the source-side deletion.
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Create marker on disk (auto-detect-rename)
        if: matrix.mode == 'auto-detect-rename'
        id: seed-rename
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
          OLD_PATH="api-commit-rename-old-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          NEW_PATH="api-commit-rename-new-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          printf 'content %s\n' "$TIMESTAMP" > "$OLD_PATH"
          {
            echo "old_path=$OLD_PATH"
            echo "new_path=$NEW_PATH"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Seed old marker on test branch via api-commit (auto-detect-rename)
        if: matrix.mode == 'auto-detect-rename'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: ${{ steps.seed-rename.outputs.old_path }}
          message: "seed old marker for rename test"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Synthetic local commit + git mv (auto-detect-rename)
        if: matrix.mode == 'auto-detect-rename'
        env:
          OLD_PATH: ${{ steps.seed-rename.outputs.old_path }}
          NEW_PATH: ${{ steps.seed-rename.outputs.new_path }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "api-commit-test"
          git config user.email "api-commit-test@example.invalid"
          git add "$OLD_PATH"
          git commit -m "synthetic local seed for rename test"
          # git mv stages both the old-path deletion and the new-path addition
          git mv "$OLD_PATH" "$NEW_PATH"

      - name: Run API Commit action (auto-detect-rename)
        id: api-commit-rename
        if: matrix.mode == 'auto-detect-rename'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          message: "chore: test API commit auto-detect rename"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # tree-unchanged: explicit file whose content matches the branch.
      # createBlob runs, but createTree produces the same tree sha as HEAD,
      # so the action skips the commit and returns empty commit_sha.
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Seed marker on branch (tree-unchanged)
        if: matrix.mode == 'tree-unchanged'
        id: seed-tree-unchanged
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
          MARKER_PATH="api-commit-tree-unchanged-$TIMESTAMP.txt"
          MARKER_CONTENT="stable content $TIMESTAMP"
          MARKER_B64=$(printf '%s' "$MARKER_CONTENT" | base64 -w0)
          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/contents/$MARKER_PATH" \
            --method PUT \
            -f "message=seed marker for tree-unchanged test" \
            -f "branch=$BRANCH" \
            -f "content=$MARKER_B64" >/dev/null
          # Write the SAME content locally — explicit-files call should produce no commit
          printf '%s' "$MARKER_CONTENT" > "$MARKER_PATH"
          echo "path=$MARKER_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run API Commit action (tree-unchanged)
        id: api-commit-tree-unchanged
        if: matrix.mode == 'tree-unchanged'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: ${{ steps.seed-tree-unchanged.outputs.path }}
          message: "chore: test API commit tree-unchanged (should be skipped)"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # file-modes: symlink (mode 120000) and executable file (mode 100755).
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Create symlink and executable (file-modes)
        if: matrix.mode == 'file-modes'
        id: seed-modes
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
          EXEC_PATH="api-commit-exec-$TIMESTAMP.sh"
          SYMLINK_PATH="api-commit-symlink-$TIMESTAMP"
          printf '#!/bin/sh\necho hello %s\n' "$TIMESTAMP" > "$EXEC_PATH"
          chmod +x "$EXEC_PATH"
          ln -s "$EXEC_PATH" "$SYMLINK_PATH"
          {
            echo "exec_path=$EXEC_PATH"
            echo "symlink_path=$SYMLINK_PATH"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run API Commit action (file-modes)
        id: api-commit-modes
        if: matrix.mode == 'file-modes'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: |
            ${{ steps.seed-modes.outputs.exec_path }}
            ${{ steps.seed-modes.outputs.symlink_path }}
          message: "chore: test API commit file modes"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # refs-heads-prefix: branch input is fully-qualified `refs/heads/X`.
      # Exercises the prefix-stripping code path that the action's default
      # `branch: ${{ github.ref }}` relies on.
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Create test file (refs-heads-prefix)
        if: matrix.mode == 'refs-heads-prefix'
        run: |
          echo "content $(date +%s)" > api-commit-refs-heads-prefix-file.txt

      - name: Run API Commit action (refs-heads-prefix)
        id: api-commit-refs-heads
        if: matrix.mode == 'refs-heads-prefix'
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: api-commit-refs-heads-prefix-file.txt
          message: "chore: test API commit refs/heads/ prefix"
          branch: refs/heads/${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # =======================================================================
      # Centralized expectation resolution + validation
      # =======================================================================
      - name: Get commit SHA
        id: commit
        env:
          EXPLICIT_FILES_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-explicit.outputs.commit_sha }}
          EXPECTED_EXPLICIT_FILES: "api-commit-test-file-1.txt,api-commit-test-file-2.txt"
          AUTO_DETECT_FILES_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-auto.outputs.commit_sha }}
          EXPECTED_AUTO_DETECT_FILES: "api-commit-auto-test-file.txt"
          NO_CHANGES_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.api-commit-no-changes.outcome }}
          TAG_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-tag.outputs.commit_sha }}
          EXPECTED_TAG_FILES: "api-commit-tag-test-file.txt"
          EXPLICIT_DEL_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-explicit-deletions.outputs.commit_sha }}
          EXPLICIT_DEL_PATH: ${{ steps.seed-explicit.outputs.path }}
          AUTO_DEL_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-auto-deletions.outputs.commit_sha }}
          AUTO_DEL_PATH: ${{ steps.seed-auto.outputs.path }}
          WORKDIR_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-workingdir.outputs.commit_sha }}
          EXPECTED_WORKDIR_FILES: "api-commit-workingdir-test-file.txt"
          WD_EXPLICIT_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-wd-explicit.outputs.commit_sha }}
          WD_EXPLICIT_OLD: ${{ steps.seed-wd-explicit.outputs.old_path }}
          WD_EXPLICIT_NEW: ${{ steps.seed-wd-explicit.outputs.new_path }}
          MIXED_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-mixed.outputs.commit_sha }}
          MIXED_OLD: ${{ steps.seed-mixed.outputs.old_path }}
          MIXED_NEW: ${{ steps.seed-mixed.outputs.new_path }}
          MIXED_AUTO_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-mixed-auto.outputs.commit_sha }}
          MIXED_AUTO_OLD: ${{ steps.seed-mixed-auto.outputs.old_path }}
          MIXED_AUTO_NEW: ${{ steps.seed-mixed-auto.outputs.new_path }}
          RENAME_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-rename.outputs.commit_sha }}
          RENAME_OLD: ${{ steps.seed-rename.outputs.old_path }}
          RENAME_NEW: ${{ steps.seed-rename.outputs.new_path }}
          TREE_UNCHANGED_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-tree-unchanged.outputs.commit_sha }}
          TREE_UNCHANGED_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.api-commit-tree-unchanged.outcome }}
          MODES_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-modes.outputs.commit_sha }}
          MODES_EXEC: ${{ steps.seed-modes.outputs.exec_path }}
          MODES_SYMLINK: ${{ steps.seed-modes.outputs.symlink_path }}
          REFS_HEADS_SHA: ${{ steps.api-commit-refs-heads.outputs.commit_sha }}
          TEST_TAG: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_tag }}
        run: |
          # Each mode resolves to: sha, expected_files (comma-joined sorted),
          # tag_name, deletion_paths (for branch-removal verification),
          # check_modes (exec_path:symlink_path or empty).
          sha=""
          expected_files=""
          tag_name=""
          deletion_paths=""
          check_modes=""
          case "${{ matrix.mode }}" in
            explicit-files)
              sha=$EXPLICIT_FILES_SHA
              expected_files=$EXPECTED_EXPLICIT_FILES
              ;;
            auto-detect-files)
              sha=$AUTO_DETECT_FILES_SHA
              expected_files=$EXPECTED_AUTO_DETECT_FILES
              ;;
            no-changes)
              if [[ "$NO_CHANGES_OUTCOME" != "success" ]]; then
                echo "::error::no-changes step did not succeed (outcome=$NO_CHANGES_OUTCOME)"
                exit 1
              fi
              ;;
            tag)
              sha=$TAG_SHA
              expected_files=$EXPECTED_TAG_FILES
              tag_name=$TEST_TAG
              ;;
            explicit-deletions)
              sha=$EXPLICIT_DEL_SHA
              expected_files=$EXPLICIT_DEL_PATH
              deletion_paths=$EXPLICIT_DEL_PATH
              ;;
            auto-detect-deletions)
              sha=$AUTO_DEL_SHA
              expected_files=$AUTO_DEL_PATH
              deletion_paths=$AUTO_DEL_PATH
              ;;
            working-directory)
              sha=$WORKDIR_SHA
              expected_files=$EXPECTED_WORKDIR_FILES
              ;;
            working-directory-explicit)
              sha=$WD_EXPLICIT_SHA
              # Sort: new vs old alphabetically
              expected_files=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$WD_EXPLICIT_NEW" "$WD_EXPLICIT_OLD" | sort | paste -sd, -)
              deletion_paths=$WD_EXPLICIT_OLD
              ;;
            mixed-explicit)
              sha=$MIXED_SHA
              expected_files=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$MIXED_NEW" "$MIXED_OLD" | sort | paste -sd, -)
              deletion_paths=$MIXED_OLD
              ;;
            mixed-auto-detect)
              sha=$MIXED_AUTO_SHA
              expected_files=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$MIXED_AUTO_NEW" "$MIXED_AUTO_OLD" | sort | paste -sd, -)
              deletion_paths=$MIXED_AUTO_OLD
              ;;
            auto-detect-rename)
              sha=$RENAME_SHA
              expected_files=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$RENAME_NEW" "$RENAME_OLD" | sort | paste -sd, -)
              deletion_paths=$RENAME_OLD
              ;;
            tree-unchanged)
              # The action should succeed (outcome=success) AND return empty commit_sha
              if [[ "$TREE_UNCHANGED_OUTCOME" != "success" ]]; then
                echo "::error::tree-unchanged step did not succeed (outcome=$TREE_UNCHANGED_OUTCOME)"
                exit 1
              fi
              if [[ -n "$TREE_UNCHANGED_SHA" ]]; then
                echo "::error::Expected empty commit_sha for tree-unchanged, got $TREE_UNCHANGED_SHA"
                exit 1
              fi
              echo "tree-unchanged correctly produced empty commit_sha"
              ;;
            file-modes)
              sha=$MODES_SHA
              expected_files=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$MODES_EXEC" "$MODES_SYMLINK" | sort | paste -sd, -)
              check_modes="$MODES_EXEC:$MODES_SYMLINK"
              ;;
            refs-heads-prefix)
              sha=$REFS_HEADS_SHA
              expected_files="api-commit-refs-heads-prefix-file.txt"
              ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Unhandled mode: ${{ matrix.mode }}"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          {
            echo "sha=$sha"
            echo "expected_files=$expected_files"
            echo "tag_name=$tag_name"
            echo "deletion_paths=$deletion_paths"
            echo "check_modes=$check_modes"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Validate commit was created
        env:
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.sha }}
          EXPECTED_FILES: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.expected_files }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          if [[ -z "$EXPECTED_FILES" ]]; then
            if [[ -n "$COMMIT_SHA" ]]; then
              echo "::error::Expected no commit to be made, but got commit_sha=$COMMIT_SHA"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Correctly produced no commit"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Commit SHA from action: $COMMIT_SHA"

          if [[ -z "$COMMIT_SHA" ]]; then
            echo "::error::commit_sha output was empty"
            exit 1
          fi

          REMOTE_SHA=$(git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$BRANCH" | cut -f1)
          echo "Remote branch HEAD SHA: $REMOTE_SHA"

          if [[ "$REMOTE_SHA" != "$COMMIT_SHA" ]]; then
            echo "::error::SHA mismatch: action returned $COMMIT_SHA but branch HEAD is $REMOTE_SHA"
            exit 1
          fi

          # `previous_filename` covers GitHub's rename detection: when the new file's
          # content matches the old one (e.g. after `git mv`), the API collapses the
          # add+delete pair into a single entry with `status: renamed`. Pulling both
          # filename and previous_filename means a renamed commit still matches the
          # expected "NEW,OLD" list.
          CHANGED_FILES=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/commits/$COMMIT_SHA" \
            --jq '[.files[] | .filename, (.previous_filename // empty)] | unique | sort | join(",")')
          echo "Files changed in commit: $CHANGED_FILES"

          if [[ "$CHANGED_FILES" != "$EXPECTED_FILES" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Expected $EXPECTED_FILES in commit, got: $CHANGED_FILES"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Commit verified successfully"

      - name: Verify file content was committed accurately (explicit-files)
        if: matrix.mode == 'explicit-files'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
        run: |
          # Defends against encoding/base64 regressions: each committed blob's
          # decoded content must byte-for-byte match the local source file.
          for p in api-commit-test-file-1.txt api-commit-test-file-2.txt; do
            REMOTE_HEX=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/contents/$p?ref=$BRANCH" \
              --jq '.content' | tr -d '\n' | base64 -d | xxd -p | tr -d '\n')
            LOCAL_HEX=$(xxd -p "$p" | tr -d '\n')
            if [[ "$REMOTE_HEX" != "$LOCAL_HEX" ]]; then
              echo "::error::Content mismatch for $p"
              echo "  local hex:  $LOCAL_HEX"
              echo "  remote hex: $REMOTE_HEX"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Content byte-exact for $p"
          done

      - name: Verify symlink target string was committed accurately (file-modes)
        if: matrix.mode == 'file-modes'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.sha }}
          SYMLINK_PATH: ${{ steps.seed-modes.outputs.symlink_path }}
          EXEC_PATH: ${{ steps.seed-modes.outputs.exec_path }}
        run: |
          # GitHub's Contents API dereferences symlinks server-side when the target
          # exists in the same repo, so we go through the Git Trees + Blobs APIs to
          # read the symlink blob's raw content (= the link target path string).
          TREE_SHA=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/commits/$COMMIT_SHA" --jq '.commit.tree.sha')
          BLOB_SHA=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/trees/$TREE_SHA" \
            --jq ".tree[] | select(.path == \"$SYMLINK_PATH\") | .sha")
          REMOTE_TARGET=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/blobs/$BLOB_SHA" \
            --jq '.content' | tr -d '\n' | base64 -d)
          if [[ "$REMOTE_TARGET" != "$EXEC_PATH" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Symlink target mismatch — expected '$EXEC_PATH', got '$REMOTE_TARGET'"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Symlink target stored correctly: $REMOTE_TARGET"

      - name: Validate deletion(s) removed the file(s) from the branch
        if: steps.commit.outputs.deletion_paths != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          DELETION_PATHS: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.deletion_paths }}
        run: |
          IFS=',' read -ra PATHS <<< "$DELETION_PATHS"
          for p in "${PATHS[@]}"; do
            if gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/contents/$p?ref=$BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "::error::File $p still exists on branch $BRANCH after deletion commit"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "File $p correctly removed from branch"
          done

      - name: Validate file modes in commit tree
        if: steps.commit.outputs.check_modes != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.sha }}
          CHECK_MODES: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.check_modes }}
        run: |
          IFS=':' read -r EXEC_PATH SYMLINK_PATH <<< "$CHECK_MODES"
          TREE_SHA=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/commits/$COMMIT_SHA" --jq '.commit.tree.sha')
          EXEC_MODE=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/trees/$TREE_SHA" \
            --jq ".tree[] | select(.path == \"$EXEC_PATH\") | .mode")
          SYMLINK_MODE=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/trees/$TREE_SHA" \
            --jq ".tree[] | select(.path == \"$SYMLINK_PATH\") | .mode")
          echo "Executable $EXEC_PATH mode: $EXEC_MODE (expected 100755)"
          echo "Symlink    $SYMLINK_PATH mode: $SYMLINK_MODE (expected 120000)"
          if [[ "$EXEC_MODE" != "100755" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Executable mode mismatch: got $EXEC_MODE, expected 100755"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$SYMLINK_MODE" != "120000" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Symlink mode mismatch: got $SYMLINK_MODE, expected 120000"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Check commit verification status
        if: steps.commit.outputs.sha != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.sha }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          # GitHub automatically signs commits created via the Git Data API,
          # so verified=true is expected regardless of which token is used.
          VERIFIED=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/commits/$COMMIT_SHA" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          REASON=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/commits/$COMMIT_SHA" --jq '.commit.verification.reason')
          echo "Verified: $VERIFIED (reason: $REASON)"

          if [[ "$VERIFIED" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Expected commit to be verified, got verified=$VERIFIED reason=$REASON"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate tag was created
        if: steps.commit.outputs.tag_name != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.sha }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.tag_name }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          TAG_SHA=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/ref/tags/$TAG_NAME" --jq '.object.sha')
          echo "Tag $TAG_NAME points to: $TAG_SHA"

          if [[ "$TAG_SHA" != "$COMMIT_SHA" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Tag SHA mismatch: expected $COMMIT_SHA but tag points to $TAG_SHA"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Tag verified successfully"

      - name: Cleanup test branch and tag
        if: always()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ steps.commit.outputs.tag_name }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          if [[ -n "$BRANCH" ]]; then
            gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$BRANCH" --method DELETE || true
          fi
          if [[ -n "$TAG_NAME" ]]; then
            gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/refs/tags/$TAG_NAME" --method DELETE || true
          fi

  # ===========================================================================
  # Negative tests: each entry is expected to fail; we assert via `outcome`.
  # No commits should land on the test branch.
  # ===========================================================================
  test-api-negative:
    name: Test API commit negative (${{ matrix.mode }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        mode:
          - overlap
          - empty-message
          - bad-branch-tag-ref
          - cross-repo-auto-detect
          - absolute-path
          - parent-traversal-path
          - missing-file
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Create test branch
        id: setup
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
          TEST_BRANCH="api-commit-neg-${{ matrix.mode }}-$TIMESTAMP"
          SHA=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/main" --jq '.object.sha')
          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/refs" \
            --method POST \
            -f "ref=refs/heads/$TEST_BRANCH" \
            -f "sha=$SHA"
          {
            echo "test_branch=$TEST_BRANCH"
            echo "initial_sha=$SHA"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Create dummy file for negative tests that need a real file
        if: contains(fromJSON('["overlap","empty-message","bad-branch-tag-ref"]'), matrix.mode)
        run: |
          echo "dummy" > api-commit-dummy.txt

      # Each negative api-commit invocation below intentionally triggers
      # `core.setFailed()`, which emits an `::error::` workflow command that
      # GitHub would otherwise surface as a run annotation. Stop-commands
      # suppresses those expected errors — the step still exits non-zero, so
      # `outcome=='failure'` registers as usual. Resumed before the assertion
      # steps so any *real* test failures still surface as annotations.
      - name: Suppress expected error annotations from api-commit
        run: echo "::stop-commands::api-commit-silence"

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # overlap: same path in both `files` and `deletions` should be rejected
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run API Commit (overlap)
        id: neg-overlap
        if: matrix.mode == 'overlap'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: api-commit-dummy.txt
          deletions: api-commit-dummy.txt
          message: "should fail: overlap"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # empty-message: blank message should be rejected
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run API Commit (empty-message)
        id: neg-empty-message
        if: matrix.mode == 'empty-message'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: api-commit-dummy.txt
          message: ""
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # bad-branch-tag-ref: branch resolving to a tag ref should be rejected
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run API Commit (bad-branch-tag-ref)
        id: neg-bad-branch
        if: matrix.mode == 'bad-branch-tag-ref'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: api-commit-dummy.txt
          message: "should fail: bad branch ref"
          branch: refs/tags/v1.0.0
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # cross-repo-auto-detect: owner/repo set to a different repo than the
      # local git remote — auto-detect should refuse to proceed.
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run API Commit (cross-repo-auto-detect)
        id: neg-cross-repo
        if: matrix.mode == 'cross-repo-auto-detect'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          owner: bitwarden-fake-owner-for-test
          repo: bitwarden-fake-repo-for-test
          message: "should fail: cross-repo auto-detect"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # absolute-path: explicit file with an absolute path is rejected
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run API Commit (absolute-path)
        id: neg-absolute-path
        if: matrix.mode == 'absolute-path'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: /etc/hostname
          message: "should fail: absolute path"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # parent-traversal-path: explicit file with a `..` prefix is rejected
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run API Commit (parent-traversal-path)
        id: neg-traversal-path
        if: matrix.mode == 'parent-traversal-path'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: ../escaping.txt
          message: "should fail: parent-traversal path"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # missing-file: explicit file that doesn't exist on disk is rejected
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run API Commit (missing-file)
        id: neg-missing-file
        if: matrix.mode == 'missing-file'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./api-commit
        with:
          files: this-file-definitely-does-not-exist-on-disk.txt
          message: "should fail: missing file"
          branch: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Resume annotation processing
        if: always()
        run: echo "::api-commit-silence::"

      # =======================================================================
      # Verify the action failed AND that no commit was made on the test branch
      # =======================================================================
      - name: Verify failure outcome
        env:
          OVERLAP_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.neg-overlap.outcome }}
          EMPTY_MESSAGE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.neg-empty-message.outcome }}
          BAD_BRANCH_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.neg-bad-branch.outcome }}
          CROSS_REPO_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.neg-cross-repo.outcome }}
          ABSOLUTE_PATH_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.neg-absolute-path.outcome }}
          TRAVERSAL_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.neg-traversal-path.outcome }}
          MISSING_FILE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.neg-missing-file.outcome }}
        run: |
          case "${{ matrix.mode }}" in
            overlap) outcome=$OVERLAP_OUTCOME ;;
            empty-message) outcome=$EMPTY_MESSAGE_OUTCOME ;;
            bad-branch-tag-ref) outcome=$BAD_BRANCH_OUTCOME ;;
            cross-repo-auto-detect) outcome=$CROSS_REPO_OUTCOME ;;
            absolute-path) outcome=$ABSOLUTE_PATH_OUTCOME ;;
            parent-traversal-path) outcome=$TRAVERSAL_OUTCOME ;;
            missing-file) outcome=$MISSING_FILE_OUTCOME ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Unhandled negative mode: ${{ matrix.mode }}"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          if [[ "$outcome" != "failure" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Expected api-commit to fail for mode ${{ matrix.mode }} but got outcome=$outcome"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Correctly failed for mode ${{ matrix.mode }}"

      - name: Verify no commit was made on test branch
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          INITIAL_SHA: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.initial_sha }}
        run: |
          BRANCH_SHA=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/$BRANCH" --jq '.object.sha')
          if [[ "$BRANCH_SHA" != "$INITIAL_SHA" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Test branch HEAD ($BRANCH_SHA) diverged from its initial state ($INITIAL_SHA) — action should not have committed"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Test branch unchanged — no spurious commit"

      - name: Cleanup test branch
        if: always()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.test_branch }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          if [[ -n "$BRANCH" ]]; then
            gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$BRANCH" --method DELETE || true
          fi

name: _publish-mcp-server-npm
run-name: Stage publish @bitwarden/mcp-server to npm

# Reusable publish logic for @bitwarden/mcp-server, called by bitwarden/mcp-server's inert
# publish-npm.yml shim. Living here (locked main, no external contributors) is what lets the
# shim reference it @main so CD can iterate independently of the CI-built, QA-tested artifact.
#
# Runs in the caller's repo context (bitwarden/mcp-server) at the dispatched commit — the
# publish-release/<version> branch deploy cuts from the release commit. The version is derived
# from that commit's package.json (the single source of truth; npm publishes that version
# regardless), and the matching CI-built artifact is promoted from the v<version> release —
# never rebuilt here.
#
# Provenance is issued by npm's trusted publisher only for this exact
# repo + workflow (publish-npm.yml) + environment (mcp-server-npm); keep this job free of any
# other OIDC login (e.g. Azure) so the environment-scoped id-token is used solely for npm.
#
# This STAGES the publish (`npm stage publish`) rather than publishing directly: the npm
# trusted publisher for @bitwarden/mcp-server is restricted to stage-only, so a maintainer
# must approve the staged package on npmjs.com with 2FA before it goes live. Provenance is
# generated for staged publishes at parity with direct publishes and carries through the
# approval.

on:
  workflow_call: {}

permissions: {}

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Stage publish @bitwarden/mcp-server to npm
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: mcp-server-npm
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      # Defense-in-depth: this publish must only ever run from a dispatch by the BRE deploy bot.
      # If someone runs the mcp-server publish-npm.yml shim by hand (e.g. on main, or
      # re-dispatches an existing publish-release branch), fail fast before touching the
      # registry. This is a backstop to the primary controls (environment branch policy +
      # publish-release ruleset).
      - name: Verify the run was triggered by the deploy bot
        env:
          _TRIGGERING_ACTOR: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$_TRIGGERING_ACTOR" != "bre-deploy[bot]" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Publish must be triggered by bre-deploy[bot]; got '${_TRIGGERING_ACTOR}'"
            exit 1
          fi

      # A bare checkout defaults to the CALLER repo (github.* is the caller's context), which
      # is bitwarden/mcp-server when invoked via its publish-npm.yml shim. Pin it explicitly so
      # it is also correct from any test caller. github.sha is the caller's commit — the
      # publish-release/<version> branch deploy cuts from the release commit.
      - name: Check out bitwarden/mcp-server at the release commit
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          repository: bitwarden/mcp-server
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Derive version from package.json
        id: version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(jq -r '.version' package.json)
          if [[ -z "$VERSION" || "$VERSION" == "null" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Could not read .version from package.json"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Resolved version: $VERSION"
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@53b83947a5a98c8d113130e565377fae1a50d02f # v6.3.0
        with:
          node-version-file: ".nvmrc"
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org/"
          cache: npm

      - name: Pin npm version
        run: |
          # npm 11.5.1+ required for OIDC trusted publishing + provenance; 11.15.0+ for `npm stage`.
          npm install -g npm@latest
          npm --version

      # package.json has `"prepare": "husky"`, which npm runs as part of `npm publish` /
      # `npm stage publish`. Without node_modules that lifecycle script fails and takes the
      # publish with it (BRE-1960). `--ignore-scripts` keeps the install itself from executing
      # any dependency scripts inside this OIDC-bearing job.
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts

      # Promote the CI-built, QA-tested bundle: download the build zip attached to the
      # v<version> release and unpack it at the repo root, which restores dist/ exactly as
      # package.json `files: ["dist"]` expects. npm force-includes README.md + LICENSE.txt +
      # package.json from the working tree (already present via the checkout). mcp-server is
      # public, so the job's GITHUB_TOKEN (contents: read) can download the release asset.
      - name: Download and unpack npm build
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          _PKG_VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          gh release download "v${_PKG_VERSION}" \
            --repo bitwarden/mcp-server \
            --pattern "mcp-server-${_PKG_VERSION}.zip"
          unzip "mcp-server-${_PKG_VERSION}.zip"

      # Stages the publish with provenance. A maintainer must approve it on npmjs.com (2FA)
      # before the version is live — bitwarden/deploy notifies #release when this completes.
      - name: Stage publish to npm with provenance
        run: npm stage publish --provenance --access public

name: "Check Permission"
description: "A composite action that checks if a user has the required permission level with configurable failure modes"
author: "Bitwarden"
branding:
  icon: shield
  color: blue

inputs:
  require:
    description: "Required permission level (admin, write, read, none)"
    required: true
  username:
    description: "Username to check permissions for"
    required: true
  token:
    [REDACTED] "GitHub token for API access"
    required: true
  failure_mode:
    description: "How to handle permission failures: 'fail' (exit 1), 'skip' (exit 0 with skip output), 'continue' (exit 0 always, use outputs for branching)"
    required: false
    default: "fail"

outputs:
  has_permission:
    description: "Whether the user has the required permission (true/false)"
    value: ${{ steps.check-permission.outputs.has_permission }}
  user_permission:
    description: "The actual permission level of the user"
    value: ${{ steps.check-permission.outputs.user_permission }}
  should_proceed:
    description: "Whether the workflow should proceed (true when permission check passes, or failure_mode is 'continue')"
    value: ${{ steps.check-permission.outputs.should_proceed }}

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - name: Check user permission
      id: check-permission
      shell: bash
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.token }}
        REQUIRE: ${{ inputs.require }}
        USERNAME: ${{ inputs.username }}
        FAILURE_MODE: ${{ inputs.failure_mode }}
        GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
      run: |
        set -e

        if [[ ! "$FAILURE_MODE" =~ ^(fail|skip|continue)$ ]]; then
          echo "::error::Invalid failure_mode; it must be 'fail', 'skip', or 'continue'"
          exit 1
        fi

        if [[ ! "$REQUIRE" =~ ^(admin|write|read|none)$ ]]; then
          echo "::error::Invalid require level; it must be 'admin', 'write', 'read', or 'none'"
          exit 1
        fi

        if [[ -z "$USERNAME" ]] || [[ ! "$USERNAME" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]{0,37}[A-Za-z0-9])?(\[bot\])?$ ]]; then
          echo "::error::Invalid username format. Username cannot be empty and must match GitHub's username requirements."
          exit 1
        fi

        if ! USER_PERMISSION=$(gh api \
          "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/collaborators/$USERNAME/permission" \
          --jq '.permission // "none"' 2>&1); then

          echo "::warning::Failed to check user permission: $USER_PERMISSION"

          if [[ "$FAILURE_MODE" == "fail" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Permission check failed and failure_mode is 'fail'"
            exit 1
          else
            # Treat API failure as "no permission" for skip/continue modes
            echo "::notice::Treating API failure as 'none' permission due to failure_mode='$FAILURE_MODE'"
            USER_PERMISSION="none"
          fi
        fi

        echo "user_permission=$USER_PERMISSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

        declare -A PERM_LEVELS=( ["none"]=0 ["read"]=1 ["write"]=2 ["admin"]=3 )

        USER_LEVEL=${PERM_LEVELS[$USER_PERMISSION]:-0}
        REQUIRED_LEVEL=${PERM_LEVELS[$REQUIRE]}

        # Check if user has required permission
        if [ $USER_LEVEL -ge $REQUIRED_LEVEL ]; then
          echo "✓ User has required permission"
          echo "has_permission=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "should_proceed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          exit 0
        else
          echo "✗ User does not have required permission"
          echo "has_permission=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          case "$FAILURE_MODE" in
            fail)
              echo "::error::User '$USERNAME' does not have required '$REQUIRE' permission."
              echo "should_proceed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 1
              ;;
            skip)
              echo "::warning::User '$USERNAME' does not have required '$REQUIRE' permission. Marking for skip."
              echo "should_proceed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
              ;;
            continue)
              echo "::notice::User '$USERNAME' does not have required '$REQUIRE' permission. Continuing - check outputs for branching."
              echo "should_proceed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
              ;;
          esac
        fi

    - name: Report results
      if: always()
      shell: bash
      env:
        USERNAME: ${{ inputs.username }}
        REQUIRED: ${{ inputs.require }}
        ACTUAL: ${{ steps.check-permission.outputs.user_permission }}
        HAS_PERM: ${{ steps.check-permission.outputs.has_permission }}
        SHOULD_PROCEED: ${{ steps.check-permission.outputs.should_proceed }}
      run: |
        echo "🤖 Permission Check"
        echo "================================"
        echo "User: $USERNAME"
        echo "Required: $REQUIRED"
        echo "Actual: $ACTUAL"
        echo "Has permission: $HAS_PERM"
        echo "Should proceed: $SHOULD_PROCEED"

name: "Report deployment status to Slack"
description: "Post a deployment status message to a Slack channel via an incoming webhook."
branding:
  icon: message-square
  color: blue
inputs:
  project:
    description: "The name of the project."
    required: true
  project_owner:
    description: "The owner/org of the project"
    default: bitwarden
  tag:
    description: "The name of the branch or tag."
    required: true
  commit_sha:
    description: "The SHA of the branch or tag."
    required: true
  environment:
    description: "The name of the environment."
    required: true
  event:
    description: "Deployment event type. One of: start, success, failure, cancelled, no-changes."
    required: true
  url:
    description: "URL of the deployment action run"
  db_migration_detected:
    description: "Whether a database migration was detected."
    default: "false"
  slack_webhook_url:
    description: "Slack incoming webhook URL to post the message to."
    required: true

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - name: Slack message setup
      id: setup
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_EVENT: ${{ inputs.event }}
        INPUT_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment }}
        INPUT_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        INPUT_PROJECT: ${{ inputs.project }}
        INPUT_PROJECT_OWNER: ${{ inputs.project_owner }}
        INPUT_URL: ${{ inputs.url }}
        INPUT_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
        INPUT_DB_MIGRATION_DETECTED: ${{ inputs.db_migration_detected }}
        GITHUB_SERVER_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        short_sha="${INPUT_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}"

        # This action can be called from other repositories with external refs/shas, so use the passed in project rather than github.repository
        repository_url="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$INPUT_PROJECT_OWNER/$INPUT_PROJECT"
        commit_url="$repository_url/commit/$INPUT_COMMIT_SHA"
        tag_url="$repository_url/tree/$INPUT_TAG"

        # Slack link format: https://api.slack.com/reference/surfaces/formatting
        commit_link="<$commit_url|$short_sha>"
        tag_link="<$tag_url|$INPUT_TAG>"

        suffix=""
        case "$INPUT_EVENT" in
          start)      prefix=':loading: Deploying' ;;
          success)    prefix=':white_check_mark: Deployed' ;;
          cancelled)  prefix=':hand: Cancelled deploy of' ;;
          no-changes) prefix=':heavy_minus_sign: No changes to deploy for' ;;
          failure)
            prefix=':x: Failed to deploy'
            suffix=$'\nPlease retry. If the issue persists, share this message in the #team-eng-bre channel for support.'
            ;;
          *)
            echo "::error::Unknown event '$INPUT_EVENT'. Expected one of: start, success, failure, cancelled, no-changes."
            exit 1
            ;;
        esac

        url_line=""
        if [[ -n "$INPUT_URL" ]]; then
          url_line=$(printf '\n%s' "$INPUT_URL")
        fi

        SLACK_MESSAGE=$(printf '%s %s to %s on %s.%s\nSHA: %s%s' \
          "$prefix" "$tag_link" "$INPUT_ENVIRONMENT" "$INPUT_PROJECT" "$url_line" "$commit_link" "$suffix")

        if [[ "${INPUT_DB_MIGRATION_DETECTED,,}" == "true" && "$INPUT_TAG" != "main" && "$INPUT_TAG" != "rc" && "$INPUT_TAG" != "hotfix-rc" ]]; then
          SLACK_MESSAGE=$(printf '%s\n:red_siren: This branch has new database migration changes.' "$SLACK_MESSAGE")
        fi

        payload=$(jq -nc --arg text "$SLACK_MESSAGE" '{text: $text}')
        echo "payload=$payload" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    - name: Post message to a Slack channel
      uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@dcb1066f776dd043e64d0e8ba94ca15cc7e1875d # v4.0.0
      with:
        webhook: ${{ inputs.slack_webhook_url }}
        webhook-type: incoming-webhook
        payload: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.payload }}

name: Test Check Review Gate Action

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: "PR number to run the gate against"
        required: true
        type: string
      event_name:
        description: "Event name to simulate"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - labeled
          - opened
          - ready_for_review
          - reopened
          - synchronize
        default: opened

permissions: {}

jobs:
  gate:
    name: Run gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repo
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run check-review-gate
        id: gate
        uses: ./check-review-gate
        with:
          event_name: ${{ inputs.event_name }}
          marker_id: bitwarden-code-review
          pr_number: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Print gate result
        env:
          SHOULD_REVIEW: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.should_review }}
          REVIEW_VARIANT: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.review_variant }}
          SKIP_REASON: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.skip_reason }}
        run: |
          echo "should_review=$SHOULD_REVIEW"
          echo "review_variant=$REVIEW_VARIANT"
          echo "skip_reason=$SKIP_REASON"

name: Test Enforce Labels

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/test-enforce-labels.yml"
      - ".github/workflows/_enforce-labels.yml"

permissions: {}

jobs:
  test-with-hold-label:
    name: Test with hold label (should fail)
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_enforce-labels.yml
    with:
      test_mode: true
      test_has_hold_label: true
    permissions: {}

  test-without-hold-label:
    name: Test without hold label (should pass)
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_enforce-labels.yml
    with:
      test_mode: true
      test_has_hold_label: false
    permissions: {}

  validate:
    name: Validate test results
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: [test-with-hold-label, test-without-hold-label]
    if: always()
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check test with hold label failed
        env:
          HOLD_TEST_RESULT: ${{ needs.test-with-hold-label.result }}
        run: |
          echo "Test with hold label result: $HOLD_TEST_RESULT"
          if [[ "$HOLD_TEST_RESULT" == "failure" ]]; then
            echo "SUCCESS: Test with hold label correctly failed"
          else
            echo "ERROR: Test with hold label should have failed but got: $HOLD_TEST_RESULT"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Check test without hold label passed
        env:
          NO_HOLD_TEST_RESULT: ${{ needs.test-without-hold-label.result }}
        run: |
          echo "Test without hold label result: $NO_HOLD_TEST_RESULT"
          if [[ "$NO_HOLD_TEST_RESULT" == "success" ]]; then
            echo "SUCCESS: Test without hold label correctly passed"
          else
            echo "ERROR: Test without hold label should have passed but got: $NO_HOLD_TEST_RESULT"
            exit 1
          fi
