name: Test Code Review Workflow

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/_review-code.yml"
      - ".github/workflows/test-review-code.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'PR number to test review on (optional, will use event PR if not provided)'
        required: false
        default: ''

permissions: {}

jobs:
  add-label:
    name: Add label
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      pr_number: ${{ steps.set-pr.outputs.pr_number }}
      timestamp: ${{ steps.set-pr.outputs.timestamp }}
    steps:
      - name: Determine PR number and add label
        id: set-pr
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          INPUT_PR: ${{ inputs.pr_number }}
          EVENT_PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [[ -n "${INPUT_PR:-}" ]]; then
            PR_NUMBER="$INPUT_PR"
          elif [[ -n "${EVENT_PR:-}" ]]; then
            PR_NUMBER="$EVENT_PR"
          else
            echo "pr_number=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "timestamp=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "⚠️ No PR context available - skipping label add"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "timestamp=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$GH_REPO" --add-label "ai-review"
          echo "✅ Added 'ai-review' label to PR #$PR_NUMBER"

  test-review:
    name: Test review
    needs: add-label
    if: needs.add-label.outputs.pr_number != ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_review-code.yml
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      pull-requests: write
    secrets:
      AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
      AZURE_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
      AZURE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}

  verify:
    name: Verify
    needs:
      - add-label
      - test-review
    if: needs.add-label.outputs.pr_number != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Check for new PR comment
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ needs.add-label.outputs.pr_number }}
          TIMESTAMP: ${{ needs.add-label.outputs.timestamp }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          NEW_COMMENTS=$(gh api "repos/$GH_REPO/issues/$PR_NUMBER/comments" \
            --jq "[.[] | select(.created_at > \"$TIMESTAMP\")] | length")

          if [[ "$NEW_COMMENTS" -gt 0 ]]; then
            echo "✅ Verify: $NEW_COMMENTS new comment(s) found on PR #$PR_NUMBER after $TIMESTAMP"
          else
            echo "::error::No new comments found on PR #$PR_NUMBER after $TIMESTAMP"
            exit 1
          fi

  cleanup:
    name: Cleanup
    needs:
      - add-label
      - test-review
      - verify
    if: always() && needs.add-label.outputs.pr_number != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Remove label
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ needs.add-label.outputs.pr_number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$GH_REPO" --remove-label "ai-review" \
            || echo "⚠️ Label may have already been removed or was not present"
          echo "✅ Cleanup complete for PR #$PR_NUMBER"

name: Test Artifact Manifest

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "artifact-manifest/**"
      - ".github/workflows/test-artifact-manifest.yml"

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build-text-file:
    name: Build Text File
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Create artifact
        run: echo "hello from build" > output.txt

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: text-file
          path: output.txt

  build-json-file:
    name: Build JSON File
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Create artifact
        run: echo '{"version":"1.0.0"}' > data.json

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: json-file
          path: data.json

  upload-manifest:
    name: Upload Manifest
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs:
      - build-text-file
      - build-json-file
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Create and upload manifest
        id: manifest
        uses: ./artifact-manifest
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        with:
          mode: upload
          gha_artifacts: |
            text-file
            json-file
          additional_artifacts: |
            {
              "server": {
                "type": "container_image",
                "registry": "bitwardenprod.azurecr.io",
                "image": "server",
                "tag": "main",
                "digest": "sha256:87dfc8005eec18f6b397e350a7f8b7ec4d1fab55f3b6534bf04fb06a04c53f27"
              }
            }

      - name: Print manifest output
        env:
          _MANIFEST: ${{ steps.manifest.outputs.manifest }}
        run: echo "$_MANIFEST" | jq .

  download-manifest:
    name: Download Manifest
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: upload-manifest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Download manifest
        id: manifest
        uses: ./artifact-manifest
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        with:
          mode: download
          run_id: ${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Print manifest
        env:
          _MANIFEST: ${{ steps.manifest.outputs.manifest }}
        run: echo "$_MANIFEST" | jq .

      - name: Print specific fields
        env:
          _SHA: ${{ fromJSON(steps.manifest.outputs.manifest).sha }}
          _REF: ${{ fromJSON(steps.manifest.outputs.manifest).ref }}
          _SERVER_DIGEST: ${{ fromJSON(steps.manifest.outputs.manifest).artifacts.server.digest }}
        run: |
          echo "SHA: $_SHA"
          echo "Ref: $_REF"
          echo "Server digest: $_SERVER_DIGEST"

  test-invalid-no-t-label:

    uses: ./.github/workflows/_enforce-pr-labels-sdlc.yml
    with:
      test_pr_labels_json: '[]'
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read

  test-invalid-multiple-t-labels:
    name: Test invalid - multiple t:* labels (should fail)
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_enforce-pr-labels-sdlc.yml
    with:
      test_pr_labels_json: '[{"name":"t:bug"},{"name":"t:feature"}]'
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read

  test-invalid-hold-label:
    name: Test invalid - hold label (should fail)
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_enforce-pr-labels-sdlc.yml
    with:
      test_pr_labels_json: '[{"name":"hold"},{"name":"t:bug"}]'
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read

  test-invalid-needs-qa-label:
    name: Test invalid - needs-qa label (should fail)
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_enforce-pr-labels-sdlc.yml
    with:
      test_pr_labels_json: '[{"name":"needs-qa"},{"name":"t:bug"}]'
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read

  validate:
    name: Validate Test Results
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs:
      - test-valid-one-t-label
      - test-valid-ignore-for-release
      - test-invalid-no-t-label
      - test-invalid-multiple-t-labels
      - test-invalid-hold-label
      - test-invalid-needs-qa-label
    if: always()
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      _VALID_ONE_T_LABEL: ${{ needs.test-valid-one-t-label.result }}
      _VALID_IGNORE_FOR_RELEASE: ${{ needs.test-valid-ignore-for-release.result }}
      _INVALID_NO_T_LABEL: ${{ needs.test-invalid-no-t-label.result }}
      _INVALID_MULTIPLE_T_LABELS: ${{ needs.test-invalid-multiple-t-labels.result }}
      _INVALID_HOLD_LABEL: ${{ needs.test-invalid-hold-label.result }}
      _INVALID_NEEDS_QA_LABEL: ${{ needs.test-invalid-needs-qa-label.result }}
    steps:
      - name: Validate results
        run: |
          failed=false

          check_result() {
            local name="$1"
            local result="$2"
            local expected="$3"
            if [[ "$result" == "$expected" ]]; then
              echo "✅ [$name] correctly got [$result]" | tee -a $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            else
              echo ":x: [$name] expected [$expected] but got [$result]" | tee -a $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
              failed=true
            fi
          }

          check_result "test-valid-one-t-label"         "$_VALID_ONE_T_LABEL"         "success"
          check_result "test-valid-ignore-for-release"  "$_VALID_IGNORE_FOR_RELEASE"  "success"
          check_result "test-invalid-no-t-label"        "$_INVALID_NO_T_LABEL"        "failure"
          check_result "test-invalid-multiple-t-labels" "$_INVALID_MULTIPLE_T_LABELS" "failure"
          check_result "test-invalid-hold-label"        "$_INVALID_HOLD_LABEL"        "failure"
          check_result "test-invalid-needs-qa-label"    "$_INVALID_NEEDS_QA_LABEL"    "failure"

          if [[ "$failed" == "true" ]]; then
            echo ":x: One or more test results were unexpected. See above for details." | tee -a $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "✅ All test results are as expected." | tee -a $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

name: Test Update PR Comment Action

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "update-pr-comment/**"
      - ".github/workflows/test-update-pr-comment.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-create:
    name: Test create comment
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      comment_id: ${{ steps.upsert.outputs.comment_id }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Determine PR number
        id: pr
        env:
          EVENT_PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          if [[ -n "$EVENT_PR" ]]; then
            echo "number=$EVENT_PR" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "::error::No PR number available. Run on a PR event."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create comment
        id: upsert
        uses: ./update-pr-comment
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr_number: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          marker_id: test-upsert-comment
          body: "Test comment created by test-create job. Placeholder tokens: {owner}/{repo}@{branch}"

      - name: Verify comment was created
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          COMMENT_ID: ${{ steps.upsert.outputs.comment_id }}
          COMMENT_URL: ${{ steps.upsert.outputs.comment_url }}
          COMMENT_CREATED: ${{ steps.upsert.outputs.comment_created }}
        run: |
          echo "Comment ID: $COMMENT_ID"
          echo "Comment URL: $COMMENT_URL"
          echo "Comment created: $COMMENT_CREATED"

          if [[ -z "$COMMENT_ID" ]]; then
            echo "::error::comment_id output is empty"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [[ "$COMMENT_CREATED" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Expected comment_created=true, got $COMMENT_CREATED"
            exit 1
          fi

          POSTED=$(gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${COMMENT_ID}" --jq .body)
          if [[ "$POSTED" != *'{branch}'* ]]; then
            echo "::error::Placeholder tokens did not survive; body was: $POSTED"
            exit 1
          fi

  test-update:
    name: Test update comment
    needs: test-create
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      comment_id: ${{ steps.upsert.outputs.comment_id }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Determine PR number
        id: pr
        env:
          EVENT_PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          if [[ -n "$EVENT_PR" ]]; then
            echo "number=$EVENT_PR" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "::error::No PR number available. Run on a PR event."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Update existing comment
        id: upsert
        uses: ./update-pr-comment
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr_number: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          marker_id: test-upsert-comment
          body: "Test comment updated by test-update job. Placeholder tokens: {owner}/{repo}@{branch}"

      - name: Verify comment was updated
        env:
          COMMENT_ID: ${{ steps.upsert.outputs.comment_id }}
          COMMENT_CREATED: ${{ steps.upsert.outputs.comment_created }}
        run: |
          echo "Comment ID: $COMMENT_ID"
          echo "Comment created: $COMMENT_CREATED"

          if [[ "$COMMENT_CREATED" != "false" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Expected comment_created=false, got $COMMENT_CREATED"
            exit 1

jobs:
  setup:
    name: Setup test issue
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      issues: write
    outputs:
      issue_number: ${{ steps.create-issue.outputs.issue_number }}
      posted_at: ${{ steps.post-comment.outputs.posted_at }}

    steps:
      - name: Create test issue
        id: create-issue
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          TIMESTAMP: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          ISSUE_NUMBER=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/issues" \
            --method POST \
            -f title="[test-respond] Automated test issue $TIMESTAMP" \
            -f body="This issue was created by the test-respond workflow to verify the respond workflow integration. It will be closed automatically." \
            --jq '.number')
          echo "issue_number=$ISSUE_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Created test issue #$ISSUE_NUMBER"

      - name: Post @claude comment
        id: post-comment
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ steps.create-issue.outputs.issue_number }}
        run: |
          POSTED_AT=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
          echo "posted_at=$POSTED_AT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/issues/$ISSUE_NUMBER/comments" \
            --method POST \
            -f body="@claude Please respond with 'hello' to confirm you are working."

          echo "Posted @claude comment at $POSTED_AT"

  verify:
    name: Verify respond workflow ran
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: setup
    permissions:
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Wait for respond workflow run
        id: find-run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          POSTED_AT: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.posted_at }}
        run: |
          echo "Polling for respond.yml run triggered after $POSTED_AT..."

          RUN_ID=""
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
          ATTEMPT=0

          while [[ -z "$RUN_ID" && $ATTEMPT -lt $MAX_ATTEMPTS ]]; do
            ATTEMPT=$((ATTEMPT + 1))
            echo "Attempt $ATTEMPT/$MAX_ATTEMPTS..."

            RUN_ID=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/respond.yml/runs" \
              | jq -r --arg since "$POSTED_AT" \
              '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.created_at >= $since and (.event == "issue_comment" or .event == "issues"))] | first | .id // empty')

            if [[ -z "$RUN_ID" ]]; then
              sleep 10
            fi
          done

          if [[ -z "$RUN_ID" ]]; then
            echo "::error::No respond.yml run found within timeout (${MAX_ATTEMPTS}x10s = $((MAX_ATTEMPTS * 10))s)"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Found run ID: $RUN_ID"
          echo "run_id=$RUN_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Wait for run to complete
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ steps.find-run.outputs.run_id }}
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for run $RUN_ID to complete..."
          gh run watch "$RUN_ID" --repo "$REPOSITORY" --exit-status
          echo "Run $RUN_ID completed successfully"

      - name: Verify respond workflow outcome
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ steps.find-run.outputs.run_id }}
        run: |
          CONCLUSION=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$RUN_ID" --jq '.conclusion')
          STATUS=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$RUN_ID" --jq '.status')
          echo "Run status: $STATUS, conclusion: $CONCLUSION"

          if [[ "$CONCLUSION" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "::error::respond.yml run $RUN_ID did not succeed (conclusion=$CONCLUSION)"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "respond.yml run verified as successful"

  cleanup:
    name: Cleanup test issue
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: [setup, verify]
    if: always()
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Close test issue
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.issue_number }}
        run: |
          if [[ -z "$ISSUE_NUMBER" ]]; then
            echo "No issue number available, skipping cleanup"
            exit 0
          fi

          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/issues/$ISSUE_NUMBER" \
            --method PATCH \
            -f state="closed"

          gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/issues/$ISSUE_NUMBER/comments" \
            --method POST \
            -f body="Automated test complete. Closing this issue."

          echo "Closed test issue #$ISSUE_NUMBER"
